name: product-photo-studio
description: Batch-prepare e-commerce product photos: remove plain studio backgrounds, crop and normalise product size and position, add ground or drop shadows, and export white-background JPGs, transparent PNGs and marketplace sizes (Taobao, Amazon, Shopify, social). Tweak any photo on its own in the side panel. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Batch-prepare e-commerce product photos: remove plain studio backgrounds, crop and normalise product size and position, add ground or drop shadows, and export white-background JPGs, transparent PNGs and marketplace sizes (Taobao, Amazon, Shopify, social). Tweak any photo on its own in the side panel. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 批量处理电商商品图：去掉纯色/浅色棚拍背景，自动裁切并统一商品大小和位置，加地面柔影或投影，导出白底 JPG、透明 PNG 和各平台尺寸（淘宝、拼多多、Amazon、Shopify、社媒）。不满意的图可以在侧栏单独调整。全部本地处理，无需 API 密钥。
